speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent, and I will be examining you today. To begin, what is your name, and what specific symptoms or concerns brought you here?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Since the mother had no prenatal care and immunization records are unavailable, was the newborn receiving breast milk or formula, and has the infant had any episodes of poor feeding or lethargy?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

The combination of a continuous heart murmur, bluish macules (petechiae) on the skin that do not blanch, cloudy lenses (cataracts), and hearing loss in a newborn is highly characteristic of the classic triad of Congenital Rubella Syndrome. Have the mother or anyone in the household had any history of fever, rash, joint pain, or flu-like illness around the time of conception or during the first trimester?
